mapper.insert: INSERT INTO digital_team_project_conversation (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, session_id, title, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{sessionId}, #{title}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM digital_team_project_artifact_lineage WHERE output_artifact_id IN ( SELECT a.business_id FROM digital_team_project_artifact a JOIN digital_team_coordinator_task t ON t.business_id = a.task_id JOIN digital_team_coordinator_plan p ON p.business_id = t.plan_id WHERE p.conversation_id = #{taskId}) OR input_artifact_id IN ( SELECT a.business_id FROM digital_team_project_artifact a JOIN digital_team_coordinator_task t ON t.business_id = a.task_id JOIN digital_team_coordinator_plan p ON p.business_id = t.plan_id WHERE p.conversation_id = #{taskId})

DELETE FROM digital_team_project_artifact WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_id IN ( SELECT t.business_id FROM digital_team_coordinator_task t JOIN digital_team_coordinator_plan p ON p.business_id = t.plan_id WHERE p.conversation_id = #{taskId})

DELETE FROM digital_team_human_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ( task_id IN ( SELECT t.business_id FROM digital_team_coordinator_task t JOIN digital_team_coordinator_plan p ON p.business_id = t.plan_id WHERE p.conversation_id = #{taskId}) OR dispatch_id IN ( SELECT business_id FROM digital_team_coordinator_dispatch WHERE conversation_id = #{taskId}) OR message_id IN ( SELECT business_id FROM digital_team_project_message WHERE conversation_id = #{taskId}) OR analysis_id IN ( SELECT business_id FROM digital_team_coordinator_analysis WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND input_snapshot LIKE CONCAT('%conversationTaskId":"', #{taskId}, '"%')) )
DELETE FROM digital_team_coordinator_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND plan_id IN ( SELECT business_id FROM digital_team_coordinator_plan WHERE conversation_id = #{taskId})
DELETE FROM digital_team_coordinator_plan WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{taskId}
DELETE FROM digital_team_coordinator_agent_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND message_id IN ( SELECT business_id FROM digital_team_project_message WHERE conversation_id = #{taskId})
DELETE FROM digital_team_coordinator_dispatch WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{taskId}
DELETE FROM digital_team_project_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{taskId}
DELETE FROM digital_team_project_message WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{taskId}
DELETE FROM digital_team_conversation_event_sequence WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{taskId}
DELETE FROM digital_team_project_conversation_expert_session WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{taskId}
DELETE FROM digital_team_prompt_execution WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{taskId}
